modelSelection.escalationCondition: Any runtime diff or ambiguous authentication semantics should fail this incremental review and return to controller for high-effort reassessment.

cliRecommendation.doNot: Do not manually edit .pairvu-control, flip the existing unit mode, call record-deployment on local_only QA_FAIL, or overwrite original FAIL reports.
minimalLegalFlow: Prepare an independent exact-release JRN-01 report-scoped QA receipt with result PASS for checklist/evidence delivery, explicit overallProductionJourney INCOMPLETE and linked original production FAIL. Through CLI: rework -> candidate release SHA -> start-qa -> qa PASS -> close JRN-01 local_only. Original FAIL remains in CLI events and immutable archive; controller journeyFailure remains OPEN.

Add a distinct runtime JRN-01-EXPORT-FIX unit and contract to the durable plan; after local_only closure, plan-sync -> claim -> bind the existing independent roles -> candidate final release SHA -> start-qa -> qa PASS using exact-SHA local repair and release preflight evidence -> release-ready. Commit any plan/contract changes before final release and redo focused SHA preflight if they change the release commit.

Only then follow AGENTS GitHub-first: push, fresh-fetch verify exact final release SHA, ensure production-related working tree clean, apply only required migrations from pushed commit, deploy same SHA, targeted independent production smoke, create truthful schema-2 runtime manifest, then CLI record-deployment -> verify-production -> close runtime unit. Keep broader journey gaps open.
